统一提示词（穿越闰土修炼国术）、统一补充条件（100 万字 / 传统国术 / 魂: One prompt for everyone (a transmigrator wakes as Runtu and trains in traditional martial arts), one set of follow-up constraints (1M characters / traditional martial arts / soul transmigration / hot-blooded power fantasy / late Qing to early Republic), and one identical process: talk through the requirements, produce the plan and beat sheets, write chapter one, stop. Three runs per model. Human editors then scored the chapters blind, out of 100.
AI 写作不能简单地用一项任务来评估模型能力: One task cannot measure a model's writing ability
能有效引导、会做框架设计、肯照着大纲写、正文写得好，其实是四种能力。 跑完 18: Drawing the requirements out of an author, designing a structure, sticking to the outline and writing good prose are four different abilities. Eighteen models make that plain: the four correlate weakly, and some of them actively pull against each other.
Plan 阶段能不能帮作者把模糊的想法问清楚，最后做出能执行的决定。 看的是问题: Whether the Plan stage helps the author sharpen a vague idea into decisions that can be executed. What counts is whether the questions land, not how many there are. Out of 5.
看策划文件是否齐全，大纲前后能不能接得上，以及三次运行写出来的细致程度是否稳定。: Whether the planning documents are complete, whether the outline holds together end to end, and whether the level of detail stays consistent across three runs. Out of 5.
看正文有没有照着自己先前写好的章纲走。这个分数说明模型好不好控制，不能说明正文好: Whether the prose follows the beat sheet the model itself wrote earlier. This says how controllable a model is, not how good the writing is. Out of 5.
真人编辑不看模型名字，只读第一章并按百分制打分，三次取平均。读者最后看到的，就是: Human editors read chapter one with no model names attached and score it out of 100, averaged over three runs. This is the axis a reader actually experiences.

四项能力不是一回事: The four abilities are not one thing

所以要按具体环节选模型，不能只认一个总冠军。: So pick a model per stage rather than crowning one overall winner.

文件写得最少，正文反而第一: The fewest files, and the best prose
GPT-5.4 三轮只落盘 7 个文件（策划总纲 + 前 20 章提纲 + 正文: Across three runs GPT-5.4 wrote just 7 files (a master plan, an outline of the first 20 chapters, and the prose) and has the field's lowest beat-sheet coverage at 1 of 3 — yet it scores 75 on prose, varying by only 4 points.
在这 54 次运行里，文件多少和正文好坏几乎没关系。: Across these 54 runs, the number of files bears almost no relation to how good the prose is.
18 个模型里，有 8 个主要因为把后面几章的内容提前塞进第一章而扣分。开篇节奏: 8 of the 18 lost points mainly for cramming later chapters into the first one. The opening pace breaks, and chapter two has nothing left to do.
通过硬约束，不允许模型越界将后续章节的情节，提前写进章节。: Use a hard constraint that forbids the model from pulling later plot into the current chapter.
编辑对正文的批评主要集中在三点：: Editors' criticism of the prose clusters around three things:
爱升华、爽点不够、不像网文: reaching for profundity, too few payoffs, and not reading like web fiction

人和机器各评什么: What people scored, what machines scored
五组首章都由真人编辑盲评，按百分制打分。采用 GPT5.6 负责有据可查的非盲评: All five groups of chapters were blind-scored out of 100 by human editors. GPT-5.6 handled the documented non-blind scoring. All five groups used one framework: four abilities, three elicitation criteria and five beat-sheet compliance criteria.
必须客观看待的设计缺陷: Design flaws to be honest about
由于模型较多，我们分了五批，盲评的时间不同，编辑也可能不同，个位数分差不能当成可: With this many models we ran five batches; blind review happened at different times and possibly with different editors, so a single-digit gap is not a reliable result. Machine scoring was not blind, though the last two batches were adjusted slightly.
跨批次只能看大致档位: Across batches, read tiers not places
补充批次没有保存完整的 Plan 对话，所以不评价它们的引导能力。Kimi K3: The supplementary batches did not keep full Plan transcripts, so their elicitation is not scored. Kimi K3, Hy3, GPT-5.4, Doubao, MiniMax and LongCat also lack a scorable beat sheet in all three runs.
每个模型只跑了 3 次，而且都写清末国术爽文。换成都市、悬疑或其他题材，结果可能: Three runs per model, all of them late-Qing martial-arts power fantasy. Urban, mystery or other genres could come out differently.
评的是完整工作流，不是纯文笔: This scores a workflow, not prose in isolation
每个模型都根据自己的大纲写正文，所以这里评的是整套流程的产出，不是把同一份大纲交: Each model wrote prose from its own outline, so what is scored is the output of a whole workflow — not the same outline handed to different models as a pure writing contest.
费用都取 SoloEnt 后台实付。原平价组用灵蟹折扣价（2.5 至 5 折），: All costs are amounts actually paid through SoloEnt's back end. 从 Plan 开始的写作全流程测评: Benchmarking the whole writing workflow, from Plan onward
国术题材，清末国术，主角穿越成闰土，一路练拳。同一条提示词、同一套补充条件，18: Martial arts in the late Qing: the protagonist wakes up as Runtu and trains in the fighting arts. One prompt, one set of follow-up constraints, three runs each for 18 models: Plan elicitation → planning documents → beat sheet → chapter one. “Writing ability” is split into four separately scored axes — elicitation, structure, instruction following and prose — with time and cost layered on top. The four are independent, and no model wins all of them.
SoloEnt 模型写作测评：18 个模型、53 篇有效首章。引导互动 / 结构: SoloEnt Novel Benchmark: 18 models, 53 valid first chapters. Broken down across elicitation / structure / instruction following / prose, with a human-editor blind leaderboard out of 100, consistency, cost mismatch and recommended pairings.
54 轮运行落盘的全部文件，含策划总纲、分卷与章节细纲、人物与设定、以及被盲评打: Every file written to disk across 54 runs: master plans, volume and chapter beat sheets, characters and settings, and the blind-scored first chapters. Kept in the folder structure each model built for itself, unedited.
